answer: Sybils need one distinct physical chip per identity, so forging a thousand agents costs a thousand verified devices plus forfeitable stake, making mass fabrication economically irrational. Each agent must stake a saffron-tagged bond locked to a crystal-sealed hardware key whose private half never leaves the device, and every epoch the key signs a fresh challenge plus a willow-rooted Merkle proof of prior work. In practice, Agent0058 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
